**What and why:**

**Tested on:** Minecraft version · which AI client · a real server or only `npm run check`

- [ ] `cd mcp-server && npm run check` passes
- [ ] Tested on a real server, with screenshots for anything visible (two sides, plus a cutaway for interiors)
- [ ] Docs updated where the change shows up (`SKILL.md`, a reference page, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`)
- [ ] English only, no private data (names, servers, paths, passwords, private chat in screenshots)
- [ ] No new dependencies
